gloss: to be mysterious; to be enigmatic; to seem puzzling

definitions.gloss: to be mysterious; to be enigmatic; to seem puzzling
definitions.explanation: to have a mysterious or puzzling quality; to give an air of mystery

notes:
A godan verb formed with the suffix めく (to have the appearance of, to seem like), attached to ⟦{謎|なぞ}→謎：03505_nazo⟧ (riddle, mystery). Almost always used in the て-form ({謎|なぞ}めいて) or た-form ({謎|なぞ}めいた) as a modifier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {謎|なぞ}めいた⟦{笑|え}み→笑み：13768_emi⟧: an enigmatic smile
- {謎|なぞ}めいた⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧: a mysterious atmosphere
- {謎|なぞ}めいた⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: cryptic words
- {謎|なぞ}めいた⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧: a mysterious figure

COMMON PATTERNS:
The suffix めく attaches to nouns to create godan verbs meaning "to have the quality of ~." Other examples include ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧めく (to become spring-like), ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧めく (to become excited/colorful), and {時|とき}めく (to feel a thrill).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧な: mysterious or strange; a more common, general-purpose adjective
- ⟦{神秘的|しんぴてき}→神秘的：21894_shinpiteki⟧な: mystical, spiritual; carries a more sacred or awe-inspiring nuance than {謎|なぞ}めく
